verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev's docs explicitly document 'waitpoint tokens' that pause a task run until an external caller completes the token, calling out approval workflows as the primary use case, and show a `needsApproval` tool pattern that keeps a run alive pending human confirmation. However several independent community comments (repeated across threads) explicitly list 'wait/resume for long running jobs' as a wish-list gap, and there's no hands-on/independent confirmation that a pause can reliably last hours-to-days in production. Missing for 10: independent verification of multi-hour/day pause-and-resume in practice, and resolution of the community-reported gap around wait/resume.
